atlasDraft.pZh: 薄簿仍合着。门槛边的信没有字，盐留在纸角。阿汐把门开着，直到潮水退去。纸没有动，盐也没有落下。渡人的船从门外经过，没有停。他看见纸角多了一道浅痕，像秤盘曾经放在那里。阿汐没有记下它。
atlasDraft.pEn: The ledger stayed closed. The letter by the threshold had no words; salt remained on one corner. Axi left the door open until the tide withdrew. The paper did not move, and the salt did not fall. The ferryman passed without stopping. He saw a faint mark on the corner, as if a scale had once rested there. Axi did not enter it.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些东西经过，不必留下重量。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some things pass without leaving a weight.
